title: Backend Intern
description:
About Us
  
At Kodo, we believe, managing a fast-growing company’s finances & operations shouldn’t feel like a juggling act. That’s why we offer a single platform to streamline all purchase decisions, automate repetitive tasks and simplify payments. From corporate cards with smart controls to accounts payable and procure-to-pay solutions, Kodo equips fast-growing businesses with everything they need to save time, cut costs, and scale easily.

Trusted by companies such as Cars24, Mensa Brands, Zetwerk and many more, Kodo transforms financial chaos into clarity. These teams are empowered with flexible corporate cards, automated vendor payments and reimbursements, and streamlined procurement processes while integrating effortlessly with their ERPs for real-time insights.

We have raised $14M from investors such as Y Combinator, Brex, and other global investors. We’re on a mission to simplify the CFO stack for fast-growing businesses. We believe in creating exceptional products for our customers, an enriching environment for our team, and a solid business that grows protably.

Job Title- Software Engineer Intern

We are looking for a **Backend Intern** to join our engineering team and work on our **B2B Enterprise SaaS product** . You will get hands-on experience in designing, developing, and maintaining backend services while working closely with experienced engineers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is passionate about backend development and wants to build their skills in modern backend technologies and software engineering practices.
  
  
Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain backend services using **Node.js** under the guidance of experienced engineers.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Assist in developing and integrating new product features.
* Build and work with **REST APIs** and backend services.
* Work with databases and third-party integrations.
* Write unit tests and follow good software development practices.
* Debug issues and help improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of backend systems.
* Collaborate with other engineers to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
* Participate in code reviews and learn industry best practices.
* Contribute to building secure and scalable backend systems.

Qualifications

* Pursuing or recently completed a **Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field** .
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, **OOP, data structures, and algorithms** .
* Good understanding of **JavaScript and Node.js** .
* Basic understanding of backend development and **REST APIs** .
* Familiarity with databases such as **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar** .
* Understanding of Git and version control.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong willingness to learn and work in a fast-paced environment.
    
    
  What You'll Learn
  + Building production-grade backend services using **Node.js** .
  + Working with modern backend technologies and architectures.
  + Designing and integrating REST APIs.
  + Working with databases and third-party integrations.
  + Writing scalable and maintainable code.
  + Backend testing and debugging practices.
  + Working in a collaborative engineering environment.
  + Understanding how a **B2B Enterprise SaaS product** is built and scaled.
      
      
    **Note:** Full-time opportunity will depend on your performance during the internship.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description:
Clearwater Analytics’ mission is to become the world’s most trusted and comprehensive technology platform for investment reporting, accounting, and analytics. With our team, you will partner with the most sophisticated and innovative institutional investors around the world. If you are infectiously passionate about what you do, intensely committed to clients, and driven by continuous innovation and improvement... We want you to apply!

We are looking for Java and Python developers to design and build scalable, cloud-native platforms for OTC and listed derivatives. You will work on trade capture, valuation, lifecycle events, risk, and post-trade processing across Interest Rate Derivatives (IRD), Credit Derivatives (CRD), FX Derivatives (FXD), and related asset classes. You will work closely with product, quants, and operations to turn complex financial workflows into reliable, well-designed software.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for derivative trade lifecycle management, valuation, pricing, risk, collateral, and reporting.
* Own the technical design of new modules and features, including architecture, data models, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Build cloud-native microservices and data pipelines using containers and managed services.
* Model and process derivative products (swaps, swaptions, caps/floors, CDS, FX forwards/options/NDFs) and their lifecycle events (resets, fixings, amendments, novations, terminations, compressions).
* Write clean, testable, well-documented code, and take part in code and design reviews.
* Improve the performance, resilience, and observability of production systems, and help resolve complex production issues.
* Mentor junior engineers and help raise engineering standards (senior profiles).

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–12 years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in derivative asset classes (IRD, CRD, FXD, or equivalent).
* Strong hands-on skills in Java (8/11/17+) and/or Python 3.x. Working knowledge of both is a plus.
* Hands-on cloud development experience on AWS including containers (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Excellent design skills: OOP, SOLID, design patterns, domain-driven design, microservices, event-driven architecture, and REST/gRPC API design.
* Working knowledge of derivative concepts: pricing and valuation basics,curves, trade lifecycle, and clearing/margining.
* Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, etc.) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar).
* Strong unit, integration, and automated testing practices.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to work with business stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with frameworks such as Spring Boot and FastAPI.
* Experience with distributed computing and low-latency design
* Exposure to observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and Agile/DevOps practices.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field. Certifications such as CFA, FRM are a plus.

title: Java Backend Engineer/Associate Director
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

Global Career Band: 4.1- Associate Director Specilaist Engineering

QORE (Quantitative Oversight Risk and Evaluation) is an internal platform that manages the full lifecycle of quantitative models — from identification and development through validation, approval, and ongoing monitoring. It supports regulatory compliance with the bank’s Three Lines of defense governance model.

We’re looking for a engineering lead to design, build, and operate microservices that power critical model risk management workflows used by validators, model owners, and risk committees globally

**In this role, you will:**

* Design and deliver features across a suite of 8+ Spring Boot microservices using hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) and CQRS patterns.
* Build and maintain domain-driven services covering model inventory, validation lifecycle, workflow orchestration, monitoring, and approvals.
* Implement and evolve BPMN/DMN workflows using Flowable for complex multi-step approval and validation processes.
* Own inter-service communication via Open Feign clients, ensuring resilience and clean API contracts.
* Write and maintain database migrations (Liquibase) and optimize PostgreSQL queries across a database-per-service topology.
* Collaborate with business analysts, model validators, and risk stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements into software.
* Contribute to platform evolution — service extraction, legacy migration, and architectural improvements.
* Maintain high code quality through automated testing, SonarQube, and peer review.

**To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:**

* 12+ years of backend development in Java (17+, ideally 21).
* Strong experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Cloud.
* Solid understanding of microservice architecture — service decomposition, API design, inter-service communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization, migrations.
* Familiarity with CQRS or similar read/write separation patterns.
* Experience with RESTful API design and OpenAPI/Swagger.
* Working experience with GCP and GKE — Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Kubernetes deployments, namespaces, health checks, and Helm charts for release management.
* Proficiency with Git (trunk-based development, branching strategies, code reviews) and CI/CD pipelines (build, test, deploy automation).
* Exposure to automated test frameworks such as REST Assured, Playwright, or similar — comfortable writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
* Experience with Flowable, Camunda, or similar BPMN/DMN workflow engines.
* Familiarity with hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) in practice.
* Exposure to Feign or declarative HTTP clients.
* Experience with Liquibase or Flyway for schema versioning.
* Experience with event-driven architecture (Pub/Sub, Kafka).
* Familiarity with Maven multi-module builds and shared library management.

Nice to Have

* Background in financial services, risk management, or regulatory technology.
* Understanding of model risk management concepts (model validation, tiering, governance).
* Experience migrating or modernizing legacy platforms.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. **Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**

* Execute automated test suites, analyze results, identify defects, and report on test coverage and quality metrics.
* Work closely with development, product management, and DevOps teams to understand requirements, define test strategies, and ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA methodologies and processes, and test documentation standards to ensure high efficiency and coverage.
* Share knowledge and promote best practices in automation testing, including test-driven development (TDD) and behavior-driven development (BDD).
* Assist in troubleshooting production issues by leveraging testing expertise and collaborating with development teams.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Proven experience (5+ years) in fintech/banking/ tech firms
* Solid experience in pl/sql development
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Familiarity with integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in an agile, cross-functional team environment.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with other programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript) for automation.
* Knowledge of performance testing and security testing principles.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Openshift, AWS).

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how.

**What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark**

* Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture
* Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents
* Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor
* Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service
* Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features
* Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load
* Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe
* Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt
* Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets

**Who You Are & What You'll Need to Succeed**

* 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience
* Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture
* Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up
* Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them
* Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline
* AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside — review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for.
* End-to-end CI/CD ownership, from build and test through packaging and deployment
* A self-starting, go-getter mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and owning a problem until it's actually solved
* Bonus: experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar) and LLM cost/observability tooling

**Why You'll Love Us**

* **We’ve evolved:** We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* **We celebrate one another’s differences:** We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.
* **We care about you:** At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* **Where can we take you?** We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

title: Salesforce Technical Lead
description:
**Salesforce Technical Lead**

**Overview:** Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced **Salesforce Technical Lead** with mandatory hands-on expertise in **Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce** and proven experience building **custom websites using Salesforce Experience Cloud**. In this role, you will own the technical direction for enterprise B2B ecommerce storefronts and customer-facing digital experiences on the Salesforce platform, leading solution design, development, integration, performance optimization, and delivery across commerce capabilities such as catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and self-service experiences. You will partner with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, and onshore/offshore engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable commerce and Experience Cloud solutions while mentoring developers and enforcing Salesforce engineering best practices.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of scalable Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2B ecommerce solutions and Experience Cloud-based customer portals.
* Build and customize Salesforce Experience Cloud websites, storefronts, portals, and self-service experiences using Experience Builder, custom themes, page templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components.
* Own solution architecture for B2B commerce capabilities, including product catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and personalized buyer experiences.
* Develop and customize commerce and Experience Cloud experiences using **Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), Flow, SOQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, and Experience Builder**.
* Integrate Salesforce Commerce Cloud with ERP, payment, tax, search, shipping, inventory, product information, and order management systems using **REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, middleware, and event-driven architecture**.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, Delivery Leads, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-architected commerce and Experience Cloud solutions.
* Provide technical leadership to onshore and offshore developers through design reviews, code reviews, estimation, troubleshooting, coaching, and delivery planning.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards for code quality, security, performance, governor-limit awareness, accessibility, release readiness, and platform governance.
* Analyze existing commerce and Experience Cloud implementations and optimize performance, scalability, usability, accessibility, and maintainability across storefront, portal, and backend components.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, deployment notes, website configuration details, and operational support guides.
* Stay current with Salesforce Commerce Cloud, B2B Commerce, Experience Cloud, Experience Builder, LWR, and platform release updates, recommending improvements that reduce technical debt and improve customer experience.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of **7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience**, including experience leading technical delivery for enterprise Salesforce implementations.
* Must have hands-on experience with **Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce**, including storefront configuration, catalog, pricing, cart, checkout, buyer groups, entitlements, and order-related workflows.
* Must have proven experience building **custom websites, portals, and self-service experiences using Salesforce Experience Cloud**, including Experience Builder, custom themes, templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components.
* Strong expertise in **Salesforce B2B Commerce on Lightning Experience, Experience Cloud, Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), and Commerce storefront development**.
* Proven experience designing and implementing B2B ecommerce capabilities such as catalogs, price books, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, reorder, account hierarchy, purchase workflows, and order management integrations.
* Advanced proficiency with **Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, SOSL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, Salesforce data models, security, sharing, and governor limits**.
* Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, tax, payment, shipping, inventory, search, identity providers, and middleware platforms using **REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, JSON/XML, and event-driven patterns**.
* Demonstrated ability to lead developers, run technical design discussions, perform code reviews, estimate work, resolve escalated issues, and guide onshore/offshore teams in Agile delivery.
* Strong understanding of scalable architecture, reusable component design, website performance tuning, accessibility, secure coding practices, release management, and Salesforce DevOps.
* Proficiency with version control and CI/CD tools such as **GitHub, Azure Repos, Salesforce DX, Azure Pipelines, or equivalent DevOps tooling**.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as **Azure Boards or Jira**.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Salesforce certifications such as **Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer, Experience Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or System Architect** are highly preferred.

title: Engineer II - Software Development
description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.

As an **Engineer II - Software Development** at **Accelya**, you will independently deliver software features and service solutions, building scalable, reliable, and well-tested systems that support Accelya's **200+ airline customers worldwide**.

**Duties & Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Design, develop, and deliver features supporting airline ticketing workflows, including issuance, voids, refunds, exchanges, and ancillary documents.
* Build and enhance cloud-native services and data pipelines on AWS for transaction processing and industry settlement reporting.
* Contribute to the modernization of legacy systems by transforming them into cloud-native architectures while ensuring accuracy, reliability, and feature parity through rigorous testing.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues end-to-end and lead root cause analysis with clear, evidence-based findings.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools for code generation, investigation, solution design, code reviews, and test creation, while rigorously validating outputs.

**Required Experience & Skills**
--------------------------------

* **3+ years (Mid-level)** or **6+ years (Senior-level)** of professional software engineering experience.
* Hands-on experience building cloud-native solutions on AWS, including services such as Lambda, Step Functions, SQS/SNS, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and serverless/event-driven architectures.
* Practical knowledge of AI and LLM-based development tools, with demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants effectively in software development.
* Strong expertise in **C#/.NET** for developing and maintaining production-grade services and APIs.
* Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
* Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, and regression testing) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of secure coding practices and handling sensitive data, including payment card and personal information.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to work US shift hours.

**Preferred Experience & Skills**
---------------------------------

* Working knowledge of **C++** and/or **Node.js/TypeScript**.
* Experience in the airline, travel, payments, or financial transaction domains.
* Familiarity with airline industry standards and settlement processes, including **IATA BSP**, **ARC**, **ATPCO**, and **IATA NDC**.
* Experience with XML/XSD-based integrations and SOAP or REST APIs.
* Experience modernizing legacy applications or migrating workloads to the cloud.
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Opportunity to work on business-critical systems that are central to global airline operations.
* Exposure to a genuine cloud modernization journey with meaningful architectural ownership.
* A collaborative, AI-first engineering culture that embraces modern tools and best practices.
* Career growth through mentorship, deep industry expertise, and clearly defined progression opportunities.

**About Accelya**
-----------------

**Accelya** is a leading global software provider serving the airline industry, powering more than **200 airlines** through its open and modular software platform. Backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, Accelya brings together **2,000+ employees across 10 global offices**. The company is a proud AWS partner and a recognized pioneer in NDC expertise.

Learn more at: **www.accelya.com**.

What does the future of the air transport industry look like to you? Whether you’re an industry veteran or someone with experience from other industries, we want to make your ambitions a reality!

title: Technical Lead
description:
**We are looking for a hands-on Technical Head who can take ownership of our overall technology and development function.**

**The person will be responsible for overseeing ongoing development, reviewing technical implementation, solving complex integration requirements, building APIs and webhooks, managing server and cloud infrastructure, and ensuring that all technology systems work reliably with our marketing, CRM, analytics, and third-party platforms.**

**This is not a purely managerial role. The ideal candidate should be technically strong enough to understand, review, troubleshoot, design, and implement solutions independently when required.**

**The candidate should have strong experience with APIs, webhooks, server-side integrations, cloud infrastructure, databases, CRM integrations, marketing APIs, conversion tracking, CAPI, offline conversions, and automation.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Development & Technical Oversight**

**- Oversee the development team and monitor the progress and quality of ongoing projects.**

**- Review technical architecture, code quality, development practices, and implementation.**

**- Understand existing applications, websites, dashboards, portals, and backend systems.**

**- Identify technical issues and provide practical solutions.**

**- Review developers' work and ensure projects are delivered according to requirements.**

**- Take ownership of critical technical tasks when the development team requires support.**

**- Ensure proper documentation of APIs, integrations, architecture, credentials, environments, and deployment processes.**

**- Establish technical standards and best practices across projects.**

**2. API Development & Integration**

**- Design, develop, integrate, and maintain REST APIs and other required APIs.**

**- Create APIs based on business, product, CRM, and marketing requirements.**

**- Develop and manage webhooks for real-time data transfer and event-based communication.**

**- Integrate third-party APIs, SaaS platforms, CRMs, payment systems, analytics platforms, and marketing platforms.**

**- Handle authentication methods such as API keys, OAuth, tokens, JWT, etc.**

**- Understand API request/response structures, JSON, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, rate limits, and error handling.**

**- Troubleshoot failed API calls, data mismatches, authentication issues, and integration failures.**

**- Build middleware or backend services where required to connect multiple platforms.**

**3. Marketing Technology & Tracking Integrations**

**A strong understanding of MarTech and performance marketing integrations is mandatory.**

**The candidate should be able to work closely with the marketing and performance marketing teams to implement and troubleshoot:**

**- Meta Conversions API (CAPI)**

**- Meta Pixel**

**- Google Ads Conversion Tracking**

**- Google Ads Offline Conversion Tracking**

**- Google Ads API / Data Manager integrations**

**- Google Analytics 4**

**- Google Tag Manager**

**- CRM integrations**

**- Lead tracking and lead lifecycle integrations**

**- Click ID tracking such as GCLID, FBCLID and other attribution parameters**

**- UTM tracking**

**- Server-side tracking**

**- Web-to-CRM integrations**

**- CRM-to-ad-platform integrations**

**- Conversion and event APIs**

**- Postback integrations**

**- S2S tracking**

**- Affiliate tracking integrations**

**- Webhook-based lead and conversion transfer**

**- Offline conversion uploads**

**- Lead status and revenue/value feedback to advertising platforms**

**The candidate should understand how a lead moves from:**

**Ad → Landing Page → Tracking → CRM → Sales/Conversion → Revenue → Marketing Platform**

**and should be able to build or troubleshoot the technical infrastructure required at each stage.**

**4. CRM & Data Integrations**

**- Integrate websites, landing pages, CRM systems, marketing platforms, and internal systems.**

**- Build APIs and webhooks for lead creation, lead updates, status changes, and conversion events.**

**- Ensure accurate transfer of lead information between systems.**

**- Implement two-way data synchronization where required.**

**- Maintain unique identifiers and event IDs to prevent duplicate conversions.**

**- Build systems for passing revenue, transaction, deposit, purchase, or other conversion values back to advertising platforms.**

**- Work with marketing teams to ensure accurate attribution and reporting.**

**5. Server & Cloud Infrastructure**

**- Manage and understand server environments and cloud infrastructure.**

**- Work with platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Cloudflare, or equivalent infrastructure.**

**- Understand domains, DNS, SSL, CDN, hosting, databases, storage, networking, and server configuration.**

**- Manage application deployment and production environments.**

**- Monitor server performance, uptime, logs, errors, and resource utilization.**

**- Troubleshoot server-side issues affecting websites, APIs, applications, and integrations.**

**- Implement appropriate security measures for APIs and backend systems.**

**- Work with developers and external infrastructure teams when required.**

**6. Database & Backend**

**- Strong understanding of backend architecture and databases.**

**- Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.**

**- Understand database structures, relationships, queries, indexing, and data integrity.**

**- Ensure reliable storage and transfer of lead, customer, transaction, and conversion data.**

**- Troubleshoot database-related issues and performance problems.**

**- Design appropriate data structures for API and integration requirements.**

**7. Technical Problem Solving**

**- Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues.**

**- Diagnose problems across frontend, backend, APIs, servers, databases, and third-party platforms.**

**- Identify whether an issue is related to code, server configuration, API, tracking, CRM, cloud infrastructure, or third-party systems.**

**- Work with developers to resolve bugs and production issues quickly.**

**- Take ownership of technical incidents until resolution.**

**8. Technology Planning & Architecture**

**- Evaluate existing technology infrastructure and recommend improvements.**

**- Design scalable technical solutions for new projects.**

**- Select appropriate technologies, APIs, services, and infrastructure based on project requirements.**

**- Review third-party tools before implementation.**

**- Ensure systems are scalable, secure, maintainable, and properly documented.**

**- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive technical and operational processes.**

**Required Technical Skills**

**Backend & APIs**

**- REST APIs**

**- API development and integration**

**- Webhooks**

**- JSON**

**- HTTP/HTTPS**

**- OAuth 2.0**

**- JWT / API authentication**

**- API security**

**- Error handling and logging**

**Programming**

**Strong hands-on knowledge of at least one backend language/framework, such as:**

**- Node.js / Express**

**- PHP / Laravel**

**- Python / Django / FastAPI**

**- Java / Spring**

**- .NET / C#**

**Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript would be an advantage.**

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

**- AWS / Google Cloud / Azure**

**- Linux**

**- Server management**

**- DNS**

**- SSL**

**- CDN**

**- Cloudflare**

**- Hosting and deployment**

**- Basic networking**

**- Monitoring and logging**

**- CI/CD**

**Database**

**- MySQL / PostgreSQL**

**- MongoDB or other NoSQL databases**

**- Database design**

**- Query optimization**

**- Data security and integrity**

**Marketing Technology**

**Hands-on experience with:**

**- Meta Pixel & CAPI**

**- Google Ads Conversion Tracking**

**- Google Ads Offline Conversions**

**- Google Analytics 4**

**- Google Tag Manager**

**- CRM integrations**

**- Server-side tracking**

**- S2S integrations**

**- Postbacks**

**- Webhooks**

**- UTM and attribution tracking**

**- GCLID / FBCLID and similar tracking parameters**

**- Conversion APIs**

**Integration Experience**

**Experience integrating platforms such as:**

**- CRMs**

**- Marketing automation platforms**

**- Payment gateways**

**- Analytics platforms**

**- Advertising platforms**

**- Affiliate networks**

**- Lead management systems**

**- WhatsApp / communication APIs**

**- Internal business applications**

**- Third-party SaaS platforms**

**Leadership Responsibilities**

**- Manage and mentor the development team.**

**- Allocate technical tasks and monitor delivery.**

**- Review development timelines and identify bottlenecks.**

**- Conduct technical reviews of major projects.**

**- Ensure developers follow proper coding, deployment, security, and documentation practices.**

**- Coordinate with marketing, sales, operations, and management teams.**

**- Convert business requirements into practical technical solutions.**

**- Work with external developers, vendors, and technology partners when required.**

**Ideal Candidate**

**The ideal candidate is someone who can both manage technology and get their hands dirty technically.**

**You should be comfortable going from a business requirement such as:**

**«"We need every qualified lead from the CRM to be sent back to Meta and Google with the correct campaign, click ID, lead status, and conversion value."»**

**to understanding exactly:**

**Where the data originates → how it is stored → which API/webhook is required → how authentication works → how the data is transformed → how it is sent → how errors are handled → how the conversion is verified.**

**Similarly, if a developer says an integration cannot be completed because "the API isn't working," you should be able to investigate the API documentation, inspect requests/responses and logs, identify the actual problem, and guide or implement the solution.**

**Qualifications**

**- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred.**

**- 6+ years of relevant technical experience.**

**- Strong backend development experience.**

**- Strong API and third-party integration experience.**

**- Hands-on experience with cloud/server infrastructure.**

**- Experience managing developers or a technical team.**

**- Strong understanding of marketing technology and conversion tracking.**

**- Experience working with CRM and advertising platform integrations.**

**- Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.**

**Key Performance Areas**

**Success in this role will be measured by:**

**- Quality and reliability of technical implementations**

**- Successful API and third-party integrations**

**- Stability of production systems**

**- Accuracy of marketing and conversion tracking**

**- Reduction in technical issues and integration failures**

**- Development team productivity and delivery**

**- API/webhook reliability**

**- Server and cloud uptime**

**- Security and scalability of systems**

**- Speed of resolving critical technical issues**

**What We Are Looking For**

**Must Have:**

**- Strong backend development knowledge**

**- API development and integration**

**- Webhook implementation**

**- CRM integration**

**- Server/cloud knowledge**

**- Database knowledge**

**- Meta CAPI**

**- Google Ads conversion/offline conversion integration**

**- GTM and GA4**

**- Server-side tracking**

**- Strong troubleshooting skills**

**- Ability to manage and review developers**

**- Willingness to remain hands-on technically**

**Good to Have:**

**- AWS / GCP certification**

**- DevOps experience**

**- Docker**

**- CI/CD**

**- Cloudflare**

**- Affiliate/postback tracking**

**- Fintech/e-commerce/ad-tech experience**

**- Experience with high-volume lead and conversion data**

**- Experience building internal automation systems**

**Role Summary**

**We are looking for a Technical Head who can own the complete technical ecosystem, from development and APIs to servers, cloud infrastructure, CRM, marketing integrations, tracking, and automation.**

**The person should be a technical problem solver first and a team manager second, with the ability to understand business requirements, architect the solution, guide developers, and personally implement critical integrations when required.**

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Have you managed or mentored a development team? If yes, how many members and in what capacity?
* Do you have hands-on experience with marketing/tracking integrations such as Meta CAPI, Google Ads Conversion Tracking (including offline conversions), GA4, and GTM? Please briefly describe your experience.
* Which backend language/framework are you most proficient in (Node.js, PHP/Laravel, Python, Java, .NET, etc.), and how many years have you worked with it?
* How many years of experience do you have building and integrating REST APIs and webhooks with third-party platforms (CRM, payment gateways, marketing platforms, etc.)?
* Are you a immediate joiner?

* Write unit and integration tests; participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards.
* Collaborate with the MDM Architect on design decisions and contribute to HLD/LLD documentation.

* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
* 10+ years of backend software development experience with at least 7 years on Java Spring Boot.
* Strong experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and event-driven patterns.
* Proficiency with AWS cloud services: RDS, S3, SQS, Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway.
* Experience building data processing pipelines for high-volume, low-latency financial data.
* Solid understanding of OAuth2, JWT, and API security best practices.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
* Domain exposure to financial data — securities, reference data, or MDM — is strongly preferred.

* Deep Java expertise: Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Spring Batch.

Microservices design patterns: CQRS, event sourcing, saga, API gateway

* Performance tuning: JVM optimization, connection pooling, database query optimization.
* Ability to translate complex domain rules (golden record logic, survivorship) into clean, testable code.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to drive technical decisions in a collaborative team environment

* Excellent communication skills and a passion for learning new technologies.

* Experience contributing to GitHub projects or open-source communities.

* Be part of a culture that values innovation, ownership, continuous learning, and engineering excellence.

### **If you believe AI is the future of software development and want to build products that redefine enterprise automation, we'd love to hear from you.**

The Lead Associate - Engineering is a senior technical authority within the engineering organisation, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high‑quality software solutions that power Davies’ UK&I technology estate. The role provides hands‑on technical leadership across modern engineering practices, cloud‑native architectures, and Agile delivery environments, ensuring that engineering squads consistently deliver robust, scalable, secure, and maintainable software. Acting as a role model for engineering excellence, the Lead Associate - AI / .NET mentors developers at all levels, promotes best practice, and drives continuous improvement in code quality, patterns, tooling, and development workflows. The role is responsible for solving complex technical problems, setting engineering direction, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure solutions meet strategic and operational objectives. This role is ideal for a highly skilled, T‑shaped engineer with deep specialism in one or more areas (back‑end, front‑end, cloud, DevOps) and broad exposure across the modern Microsoft‑centric stack including .NET, C#, React/TypeScript, Azure, Terraform, and SQL Server.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design and development of high‑quality, cloud‑native applications aligned to strategic technologies.
* Write clean, maintainable, secure code following SOLID principles, design patterns, and OWASP guidelines.
* Develop microservices, containerised applications, and event‑driven components.
* Implement automated testing approaches including TDD, integration testing, and CI/CD pipeline automation.
* Support SRE (site reliability engineering) practices such as observability, resilience engineering, and performance tuning.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* 8–10+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong proficiency in **C# and .NET** (or Python).
* Modern front‑end experience with **React**, Angular, or Vue.
* Advanced experience with **Azure** (or AWS/GCP equivalents).
* Strong expertise in **microservices**, event‑driven architecture, and Domain‑Driven Design.
* Strong SQL Server and Entity Framework capabilities.
* Test‑driven development and automated test practices.
* CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling.
* Secure coding practices and familiarity with OWASP principles.

  

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Senior Backend JS Developer
description:
Lead the backend architecture behind server-side systems that have to stay fast, reliable, and secure under real production load. As a Senior Node.js Web Developer at Talentica, you’ll work with our client Autodesk, building TypeScript-based Node.js services and RESTful APIs, solving engineering challenges such as asynchronous, event-driven architecture at scale.

### **What You'll Own**

* Design and build server-side services in Node.js and TypeScript, using frameworks like Express.js or Nest.js.
* Own the RESTful APIs connecting front-end and back-end systems, including their performance and reliability.
* Design database schemas and optimize queries across MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
* Implement authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth) to protect sensitive data.
* Own code quality across the team: lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and debug production issues.
* Work with DevOps to ensure smooth deployment and integration, and maintain technical documentation for the codebase and APIs.

### **What We Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience developing back-end applications using Node.js.
* Exceptional proficiency in TypeScript.
* Advanced expertise in one or more web frameworks (e.g., Express.js, Nest.js).
* In-depth understanding of server-side JavaScript, asynchronous programming, and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with databases such as MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., JWT, OAuth).
* Knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript) is a plus.
* Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

### **Why It's Worth Your Time**

* You'll bring AI-assisted tools into your daily TypeScript and Node.js development workflow.
* Owning API performance and database design for a production system is how you'll grow into a stronger backend architect.
* You'll be guided by hands-on senior engineers who review your API and database design closely, and help you grow.
* You'll be surrounded by talented peers with strong educational backgrounds, and pushed to sharpen your backend architecture instincts working alongside them.

### **About Talentica**

Since 2003, Talentica has built software exclusively for tech companies — from early-stage startups to large, established enterprises. We've partnered with startups from their earliest stages through to successful acquisitions, doing the kind of deep product and engineering work that moves a company's valuation, not generalist consulting or staff augmentation. Our ~600-person team is among the strongest in the industry, drawn heavily from the IITs and NITs — which means the software you'll build is genuinely differentiated, and the work is demanding enough that you'll keep learning regardless of how senior you are.

* Develop microservices, containerised applications, and event‑driven components.
* Implement automated testing approaches including TDD, integration testing, and CI/CD pipeline automation.

title: Production Support, Spring boot, API, Microservices / Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist


In this role, you will:

* Provide second\- and third\-line production and application support across a portfolio of Java and Spring Boot micro\-services, application programming interfaces (APIs) and scheduled batch jobs, keeping services healthy across multiple regions and time zones.
* Manage the incident, problem and change lifecycle: restore service during outages, lead root\-cause analysis, raise and implement controlled change requests, and maintain runbooks, implementation, rollback and audit evidence.
* Investigate and resolve production defects by analysing application logs, database queries (Structured Query Language, SQL) and API behaviour; deliver low\- to medium\-complexity code and configuration fixes and validate them through to release.
* Monitor application and API health using enterprise observability tooling such as AppDynamics, Splunk and the Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana (ELK) stack; tune alerting rules and action or suppress alerts during planned events.
* Support reference\-data synchronisation, data patching and ad\-hoc data\-extraction requests for business users, business analysts and architects, and support production\-like and post\-release verification testing.
* Deliver IT service management and governance activities, including vulnerability\-remediation tracking, certificate management, access and entitlement reviews, business impact analysis, service\-recovery and backup\-and\-restore exercises, and internal and external audit support.
* Plan and support releases, role\-swaps and business\-continuity events, and contribute to release handovers, retrospectives and change\-control forums to protect service stability.
* Provide rota\-based on\-call and out\-of\-hours production support covering Asia, Middle East and North Africa (MENA), United Kingdom (UK) and United States (US) business hours, and drive continuous improvement to reduce manual effort.


To be successful, you will:

* Demonstrate hands\-on IT service management and production\-support experience, including incident, problem and change management, root\-cause analysis and supporting live, business\-critical applications.
* Have practical Java (version 8 or above) and Spring Boot development or support experience, with the ability to read code, debug issues and deliver controlled fixes using Maven, JUnit and Structured Query Language (SQL).
* Understand application programming interfaces (APIs), web and micro\-services (Representational State Transfer, REST, and Simple Object Access Protocol, SOAP), service\-oriented architecture and API integration.
* Be comfortable with relational and non\-relational databases (ideally Oracle and MongoDB) and able to write and troubleshoot queries to investigate production issues.
* Have working knowledge of monitoring and service\-management tooling such as AppDynamics, Splunk, ELK, ServiceNow, JIRA and Confluence, and of engineering and quality tooling such as Git, Jenkins, SonarQube and Checkmarx.
* Have exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF); knowledge of GCP or an enterprise Kubernetes platform is an advantage.
* Bring strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, the ability to work calmly in a dynamic and unpredictable production environment, and a continuous\-improvement mindset.
* Communicate clearly with development, infrastructure, security and business teams, maintain accurate documentation and change evidence, and participate in agreed on\-call and out\-of\-hours support arrangements.


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Technical Design Lead for Salesforce Field Service Management
description:
Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world has helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes , Corporate Knights for clean capitalism and others.


KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market.


**KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI)** is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.


**KONE IT** is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud\-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption. Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation are at the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part of KONE’s success.

  

You will own the architecture, technical design, configuration, development and design related to our Field Service Management solution (FSM). KONE was the first company in the world to partner with Salesforce on the Field Service Management, and through that co\-creation FSM entity is built on top of Salesforce Field Service Lightning solution, combined with custom built mobile experience for tens of thousands of field technicians.


As the Technical Design Lead you will lead and guide internal and external teams in developing and implementing FSM. You are responsible for establishing guidelines and processes, as well as validating and approving all designs. You will work closely also with Product Owners and Enterprise Architects to drive solution architecture, enabling high performance, maintainability, scalability and security.


Main Responsibilities


* Own the technical design and solution both for FSM Core and FSM Mobile
* Own the solution functionality design as per approved demands, and translate those to IT functional and technical requirements
* Defines the optimal configuration with maximal utilization of out\-of\-the\-box functionality vs KONE\-specific customization
* Support in defining data model and controlling data integrity for the solutions
* Support application support teams and KONE service management in problem management
* Support FSM license management
* Ensure that solution development is in line with business objectives, user needs, target architecture and IT standards \& frameworks
* Ensure the solution documentation is always up\-to\-date
* Understand the FSM solution big\-picture and the target state and it’s role in IT landscape and service business processes.

The desired candidate will have


* M.Sc. degree or equivalent
* Professional experience of minimum 12 years in IT industry, with at least 8 years in Salesforce
* Expertise and hands on experience in Salesforce Field Service Lightning and Service Cloud products and their implementation
* Expertise and hands on experience in custom mobile architectures
* Good knowledge of handling \& simplifying Salesforce data integration designs with backend systems like SAP, IoT etc.
* Salesforce App Builder and Developer certification(s). Other Salesforce certification(s) are an added advantage
* Demonstrated track record of clear achievements from previous positions held
* Experience in leadership and matrix organizations
* Experience with supplier collaboration / collaboration with development partners
* Experience in working in international environment with stakeholders distributed globally
* Excellent stakeholders’ communication skills (both written and oral)
* Excellent change management, analysis and problem solving skills
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills in English

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C\#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps.

title: AI-Native Java Backend Engineer
description:

Zycus is a global leader in Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) procurement software, helping large enterprises drive efficiency, compliance, and measurable value across their procurement and finance operations. Trusted by leading Fortune 1000 organizations worldwide, Zycus enables procurement teams to move from cost control to strategic value creation.
At the core of Zycus’ platform is **Merlin AI**, an advanced AI\-powered engine that brings intelligence, automation, and predictive insights across the entire procurement lifecycle—from sourcing and contract management to procurement, invoicing, and supplier management. Merlin AI empowers Chief Procurement Officers and finance leaders to make faster, smarter decisions with real\-time visibility and actionable insights.
Zycus is consistently recognized by top industry analysts such as **Gartner, Forrester, and IDC** for its innovation, depth of functionality, and strong customer outcomes. Known for its enterprise\-grade solutions, global delivery model, and customer\-first mindset, Zycus partners closely with organizations to modernize procurement and unlock long\-term business value.
With a strong global presence across North America, EMEA, and APAC, Zycus continues to invest aggressively in product innovation, AI\-led capabilities, and brand leadership—shaping the future of intelligent procurement.  

  

**We Are An Equal Opportunity Employer:**

We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. **Job Description**


We are seeking a Core Java Developer with strong backend engineering fundamentals and practical exposure to Generative AI technologies. * Design, develop, and deploy scalable, secure, and maintainable **Java\-based backend systems** using Java (core/advanced/framework) or any other JVM technology.

* Integrate front\-end and back\-end systems, ensuring seamless data exchange and user experience.
* Work with **REST APIs**, **JWT authentication**, and **cloud\-based deployment environments** (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (DevOps, QA, Product, UX) in an Agile/Scrum environment.

* Stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices in **AI\-assisted software development**.

### **Required Skills \& Experience**


* **3\+ years** of hands\-on experience in **Java development**.
* Strong proficiency in **Spring Framework**, **Spring Boot**, and **Microservices architecture**.
* Strong expertise in Core Java and object\-oriented programming
* Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
* Hands\-on experience with multi\-threading and concurrency
* Experience with **REST APIs**, **JSON**, **JPA/Hibernate**, and **SQL/NoSQL databases**.
* Knowledge of **CI/CD pipelines** (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).

* Exposure to **Docker, Kubernetes**, and **containerized deployments**.
* Understanding of **event\-driven architectures** (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Familiarity with **Test\-Driven Development (TDD)** or **Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD)**.
* Contributions to **open\-source projects** or **AI\-assisted coding communities**.

### **Why Join Us**


* Work on **cutting\-edge applications** powered by **AI\-assisted development workflows**.
* Collaborate with a **forward\-thinking engineering team** that values innovation and continuous learning.
* Access to **premium AI development tools** to boost productivity and code quality.
* Competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for **career advancement**
  

  

**About Zycus:**
Zycus, recognized by leading analyst firms in procurement technology, empowers teams to unlock deep value through its comprehensive Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) solutions. At the heart of our S2P solution is the Merlin Agentic Platform, which orchestrates intelligent AI agents to deliver simplified, efficient, and compliant processes.
The Merlin Intake Agent offers business users unparalleled ease of use, increasing adoption rates and significantly reducing non\-compliant spending. For procurement teams, the Merlin Autonomous Negotiation Agent handles tail spend autonomously, securing additional savings; the Merlin Contract Agent helps draft compliant contracts and reduces risks by actively monitoring them; and the Merlin AP Agent further enhances efficiency by automating invoice processing with exceptional speed and accuracy.

title: Sr. Engineer - Cloud
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

 **About the Role:**


We're hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third\-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.


Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is the Falcon product used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime of apps built by our Foundry Module, and is 'dogfooded' by us internally to automate other workflows and speed up development. With these many varied uses, it can be responsible for processing anywhere from 500M to 10B\+ events/day and is in use by essentially every single customer of the Falcon Platform.


This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability and scalability will be key ingredients to your success here at CrowdStrike.

**What You'll Do:**

* Build production\-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to the core platform services that power connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.
* Drive architectural decisions for connector platform design, evaluating tradeoffs between scalability,reliability, and developer experience
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers on distributed systems design, authentication protocols, and production operations best practices
* You'll own connectors end\-to\-end—from API research through deployment and production support—while improving the platform capabilities (auth systems, testing frameworks, deployment pipelines) that all connectors depend on
* Research, evaluate, and integrate new security platforms and APIs to expand our connector portfolio
* Develop both connectors and platform services, working with authentication mechanisms (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, API keys) at both the connector and platform layer
* Build and maintain automated testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines that ensure connector quality and reliability across multi\-region deployments
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with existing connectors and platform services, taking operational ownership of incidents across our fleet of Falcon environments
* Write technical documentation including integration guides, API specifications, and troubleshooting runbooks

**What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience
* 10\+ years of experience designing, implementing, and maintaining multiple software products/systems/releases, preferably in a SaaS delivery model, across all phases of the development lifecycle
* Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably in Python or Go
* Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs
* Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases
* Deep expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs with a track record of making architectural decisions at scale
* Hands\-on experience in large\-scale (distributed) system architecture, high scalability and availability, and optimization
* Strong debugging skills
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
* Strong communication skills; working collaboratively and confidently with internal stakeholders

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience with commercial clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Contributions to the open source community
* Golang experience
* Prior experience with (cybersecurity) platforms or integrations.

  

\#LI\-SM2

 **Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:**

* Market leader in compensation and equity awards
* Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
* Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
* Paid parental and adoption leaves
* Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
