description:
We are looking for a hands\-on Technical Head who can take ownership of our overall technology and development function.

The person will be responsible for overseeing ongoing development, reviewing technical implementation, solving complex integration requirements, building APIs and webhooks, managing server and cloud infrastructure, and ensuring that all technology systems work reliably with our marketing, CRM, analytics, and third\-party platforms.

This is not a purely managerial role. The ideal candidate should be technically strong enough to understand, review, troubleshoot, design, and implement solutions independently when required.

The candidate should have strong experience with APIs, webhooks, server\-side integrations, cloud infrastructure, databases, CRM integrations, marketing APIs, conversion tracking, CAPI, offline conversions, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Development \& Technical Oversight

\- Oversee the development team and monitor the progress and quality of ongoing projects.

\- Review technical architecture, code quality, development practices, and implementation.

\- Understand existing applications, websites, dashboards, portals, and backend systems.

\- Identify technical issues and provide practical solutions.

\- Review developers' work and ensure projects are delivered according to requirements.

\- Take ownership of critical technical tasks when the development team requires support.

\- Ensure proper documentation of APIs, integrations, architecture, credentials, environments, and deployment processes.

\- Establish technical standards and best practices across projects.

2\. API Development \& Integration

\- Design, develop, integrate, and maintain REST APIs and other required APIs.

\- Create APIs based on business, product, CRM, and marketing requirements.

\- Develop and manage webhooks for real\-time data transfer and event\-based communication.

\- Integrate third\-party APIs, SaaS platforms, CRMs, payment systems, analytics platforms, and marketing platforms.

\- Handle authentication methods such as API keys, OAuth, tokens, JWT, etc.

\- Understand API request/response structures, JSON, HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, rate limits, and error handling.

\- Troubleshoot failed API calls, data mismatches, authentication issues, and integration failures.

\- Build middleware or backend services where required to connect multiple platforms.

3\. Marketing Technology \& Tracking Integrations

A strong understanding of MarTech and performance marketing integrations is mandatory.

The candidate should be able to work closely with the marketing and performance marketing teams to implement and troubleshoot:

\- Meta Conversions API (CAPI)

\- Meta Pixel

\- Google Ads Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads Offline Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads API / Data Manager integrations

\- Google Analytics 4

\- Google Tag Manager

\- CRM integrations

\- Lead tracking and lead lifecycle integrations

\- Click ID tracking such as GCLID, FBCLID and other attribution parameters

\- UTM tracking

\- Server\-side tracking

\- Web\-to\-CRM integrations

\- CRM\-to\-ad\-platform integrations

\- Conversion and event APIs

\- Postback integrations

\- S2S tracking

\- Affiliate tracking integrations

\- Webhook\-based lead and conversion transfer

\- Offline conversion uploads

\- Lead status and revenue/value feedback to advertising platforms

The candidate should understand how a lead moves from:

Ad → Landing Page → Tracking → CRM → Sales/Conversion → Revenue → Marketing Platform

and should be able to build or troubleshoot the technical infrastructure required at each stage.

4\. CRM \& Data Integrations

\- Integrate websites, landing pages, CRM systems, marketing platforms, and internal systems.

\- Build APIs and webhooks for lead creation, lead updates, status changes, and conversion events.

\- Ensure accurate transfer of lead information between systems.

\- Implement two\-way data synchronization where required.

\- Maintain unique identifiers and event IDs to prevent duplicate conversions.

\- Build systems for passing revenue, transaction, deposit, purchase, or other conversion values back to advertising platforms.

\- Work with marketing teams to ensure accurate attribution and reporting.

5\. Server \& Cloud Infrastructure

\- Manage and understand server environments and cloud infrastructure.

\- Work with platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Cloudflare, or equivalent infrastructure.

\- Understand domains, DNS, SSL, CDN, hosting, databases, storage, networking, and server configuration.

\- Manage application deployment and production environments.

\- Monitor server performance, uptime, logs, errors, and resource utilization.

\- Troubleshoot server\-side issues affecting websites, APIs, applications, and integrations.

\- Implement appropriate security measures for APIs and backend systems.

\- Work with developers and external infrastructure teams when required.

6\. Database \& Backend

\- Strong understanding of backend architecture and databases.

\- Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases.

\- Understand database structures, relationships, queries, indexing, and data integrity.

\- Ensure reliable storage and transfer of lead, customer, transaction, and conversion data.

\- Troubleshoot database\-related issues and performance problems.

\- Design appropriate data structures for API and integration requirements.

7\. Technical Problem Solving

\- Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues.

\- Diagnose problems across frontend, backend, APIs, servers, databases, and third\-party platforms.

\- Identify whether an issue is related to code, server configuration, API, tracking, CRM, cloud infrastructure, or third\-party systems.

\- Work with developers to resolve bugs and production issues quickly.

\- Take ownership of technical incidents until resolution.

8\. Technology Planning \& Architecture

\- Evaluate existing technology infrastructure and recommend improvements.

\- Design scalable technical solutions for new projects.

\- Select appropriate technologies, APIs, services, and infrastructure based on project requirements.

\- Review third\-party tools before implementation.

\- Ensure systems are scalable, secure, maintainable, and properly documented.

\- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive technical and operational processes.

Required Technical Skills

Backend \& APIs

\- REST APIs

\- API development and integration

\- Webhooks

\- JSON

\- HTTP/HTTPS

\- OAuth 2\.0

\- JWT / API authentication

\- API security

\- Error handling and logging

Programming

Strong hands\-on knowledge of at least one backend language/framework, such as:

\- Node.js / Express

\- PHP / Laravel

\- Python / Django / FastAPI

\- Java / Spring

\- .NET / C\#

Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript would be an advantage.

Cloud \& Infrastructure

\- AWS / Google Cloud / Azure

\- Linux

\- Server management

\- DNS

\- SSL

\- CDN

\- Cloudflare

\- Hosting and deployment

\- Basic networking

\- Monitoring and logging

\- CI/CD

Database

\- MySQL / PostgreSQL

\- MongoDB or other NoSQL databases

\- Database design

\- Query optimization

\- Data security and integrity

Marketing Technology

Hands\-on experience with:

\- Meta Pixel \& CAPI

\- Google Ads Conversion Tracking

\- Google Ads Offline Conversions

\- Google Analytics 4

\- Google Tag Manager

\- CRM integrations

\- Server\-side tracking

\- S2S integrations

\- Postbacks

\- Webhooks

\- UTM and attribution tracking

\- GCLID / FBCLID and similar tracking parameters

\- Conversion APIs

Integration Experience

Experience integrating platforms such as:

\- CRMs

\- Marketing automation platforms

\- Payment gateways

\- Analytics platforms

\- Advertising platforms

\- Affiliate networks

\- Lead management systems

\- WhatsApp / communication APIs

\- Internal business applications

\- Third\-party SaaS platforms

Leadership Responsibilities

\- Manage and mentor the development team.

\- Allocate technical tasks and monitor delivery.

\- Review development timelines and identify bottlenecks.

\- Conduct technical reviews of major projects.

\- Ensure developers follow proper coding, deployment, security, and documentation practices.

\- Coordinate with marketing, sales, operations, and management teams.

\- Convert business requirements into practical technical solutions.

\- Work with external developers, vendors, and technology partners when required.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is someone who can both manage technology and get their hands dirty technically.

You should be comfortable going from a business requirement such as:

«"We need every qualified lead from the CRM to be sent back to Meta and Google with the correct campaign, click ID, lead status, and conversion value."»

to understanding exactly:

Where the data originates → how it is stored → which API/webhook is required → how authentication works → how the data is transformed → how it is sent → how errors are handled → how the conversion is verified.

Similarly, if a developer says an integration cannot be completed because "the API isn't working," you should be able to investigate the API documentation, inspect requests/responses and logs, identify the actual problem, and guide or implement the solution.

**Qualifications**

\- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

\- 6\+ years of relevant technical experience.

\- Strong backend development experience.

\- Strong API and third\-party integration experience.

\- Hands\-on experience with cloud/server infrastructure.

\- Experience managing developers or a technical team.

\- Strong understanding of marketing technology and conversion tracking.

\- Experience working with CRM and advertising platform integrations.

\- Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

**Key Performance Areas**

Success in this role will be measured by:

\- Quality and reliability of technical implementations

\- Successful API and third\-party integrations

\- Stability of production systems

\- Accuracy of marketing and conversion tracking

\- Reduction in technical issues and integration failures

\- Development team productivity and delivery

\- API/webhook reliability

\- Server and cloud uptime

\- Security and scalability of systems

\- Speed of resolving critical technical issues

**What We Are Looking For**

Must Have:

\- Strong backend development knowledge

\- API development and integration

\- Webhook implementation

\- CRM integration

\- Server/cloud knowledge

\- Database knowledge

\- Meta CAPI

\- Google Ads conversion/offline conversion integration

\- GTM and GA4

\- Server\-side tracking

\- Strong troubleshooting skills

\- Ability to manage and review developers

\- Willingness to remain hands\-on technically

**Good to Have:**

\- AWS / GCP certification

\- DevOps experience

\- Docker

\- CI/CD

\- Cloudflare

\- Affiliate/postback tracking

\- Fintech/e\-commerce/ad\-tech experience

\- Experience with high\-volume lead and conversion data

\- Experience building internal automation systems

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Technical Head who can own the complete technical ecosystem, from development and APIs to servers, cloud infrastructure, CRM, marketing integrations, tracking, and automation.

The person should be a technical problem solver first and a team manager second, with the ability to understand business requirements, architect the solution, guide developers, and personally implement critical integrations when required.

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Have you managed or mentored a development team? If yes, how many members and in what capacity?
* Are you a immediate joiner?
* Do you have hands\-on experience with marketing/tracking integrations such as Meta CAPI, Google Ads Conversion Tracking (including offline conversions), GA4, and GTM? Please briefly describe your experience.
* Which backend language/framework are you most proficient in (Node.js, PHP/Laravel, Python, Java, .NET, etc.), and how many years have you worked with it?
* How many years of experience do you have building and integrating REST APIs and webhooks with third\-party platforms (CRM, payment gateways, marketing platforms, etc.)?

Work Location: In person

title: Software Engineering Specialist - JAVA
description:
**Software Engineering Specialist \- JAVA**


Dassault Systemes' ENOVIA is the world's leading solution for collaborative product development and lifecycle management. Deployed by global leaders such as Honda, Toyota, Boeing, and Airbus — across 12 industries spanning mobility, aerospace, life sciences, and infrastructure — it manages the complete journey of a product from concept to end\-of\-life.  

The ENOVIA India R\&D team, designs and builds the next generation of PLM solutions on cloud. Our products directly influence how the world's manufacturers design, validate, change, and realize complex products. We work in an AI\-augmented engineering model: leverage AI tools to accelerate delivery; human engineers provide the domain judgment, architectural oversight, and quality validation that AI cannot replace.  

As a Java Developer in ENOVIA R\&D India, you will design, develop, and maintain server\-side Java components that power the ENOVIA applications — that are central to how the world's leading organizations manage their product lifecycle. You will work on backend services and data modeling, where reliability, scalability, and data integrity are foundational requirements.  

You will leverage AI coding assistants to accelerate development of Java services while applying disciplined review to validate generated output for correctness, security, and compliance with design standards. You should understand where AI assistance is genuinely useful in core Java development, and where human precision is irreplaceable.

**Role Description \& Responsibilities**

* Define, develop, and maintain software modules and features with a focus on reliability, scalability, and data integrity.
* As part of an AI\-enabled SDLC, leverage AI coding assistants for development, code reviews, and test case generation, while ensuring the quality and safety of AI\-generated output.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to translate product requirements into implementations
* Resolve technical issues through debugging, research, and investigation — creating new and innovative ways to improve platform applications.
* Work closely with customers on real\-time production issues, providing timely diagnosis and resolution.
* Collaborate effectively with a geographically distributed team.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers; contribute to hiring and team\-building efforts.


 PLM / Domain Skills  

* Development exposure to ENOVIA or equivalent PLM platforms
* Awareness of PLM domain concepts: BOM, Engineering Change Management, Product Configuration, Document Management
* Industry exposure: automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, life sciences, infrastructure (nice to have)

**AI Skills**  

* Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) in real workflow
* Critical review of AI\-generated code: logic errors, security risks, edge cases, style
* Effective prompt writing and iterative refinement of AI output
* AI for non\-code tasks: requirement drafting, test case generation, documentation

**Software Engineering Skills**  

* CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, OOD, design patterns — applied to applications in production
* Strong debugging and root\-cause analysis across distributed codebases
* Good knowledge of DevOps and Cloud technologies; ability to write basic SQL queries.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot applications and environment issues.

**JAVA Skills**  

* Strong core Java proficiency — Java 11 or later; solid understanding of the Java memory model, garbage collection, and JVM behavior.
* Experience with Java/J2EE, JMS, Message Broker, and Java stack technologies in a professional product or enterprise context.
* Strong system thinking skills to design and build scalable, reliable, and maintainable Java\-based backend systems
* Good knowledge of Client\-Server architectures and RESTful API design.

**Collaboration \& Soft Skills**  

* Good team spirit and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent written, Verbal, Communication skills, Analytical skills \& Business thinking.
* Adaptability, ability to learn faster, to be independent, responsible and diligent
**Qualifications**

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Sciences, or a related discipline from a reputed institution with a good academic track record.
* 2 to 4 years of hands\-on professional experience with design and development of complex Java software products, with exposure to unit testing tools.

**What's in It for You**

* Work at the intersection of deep PLM domain expertise and AI\-augmented engineering; a rare combination that will define the highest\-value development of the decade.
* Contribute to products used by global industry leaders across 12 sectors, directly influencing how major manufacturers design and build the products we all use.
* Grow in an environment that values engineering craft, domain curiosity, and AI fluency equally; not just raw coding.
* Collaborate with engineering colleagues across the globe as part of a world\-class PLM organization.
* Be part of a team actively shaping how AI is integrated into enterprise product engineering \- from the inside.
**Inclusion statement**
-----------------------


As a game\-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

description:
Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.  

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare. **About the role**
Retail OS powers live store operations across fulfilment, delivery, complaints, and operational incidents. We are hiring an SDE \- 2 or 3 who has built and operated products at scale and can bring that engineering discipline to AI agents, root\-cause analysis, attribution, and autonomous workflows.
You will own services and features from design through production, combining performance, availability, and recovery engineering with applied AI. You will partner with senior engineers, operations teams, and upstream platform owners. **What you will do*** Build scalable backend services and event\-processing pipelines with measurable throughput, latency, and availability objectives.
* Improve performance through profiling, efficient data access, concurrency management, capacity planning, and load testing.
* Engineer resilience through replication, failover, backpressure, graceful degradation, and recovery procedures; validate backup restoration and disaster recovery.
* Build incident correlation, root\-cause analysis, and attribution systems that reconstruct operational timelines and link conclusions to evidence.
* Develop agents that investigate incidents using operational data, metrics, and runbooks, then execute permitted actions with deduplication, audit trails, escalation, and verified closure.
* Own production health through observability, on\-call participation, incident response, postmortems, and preventive improvements.

**What you must bring*** **Experience operating products at scale:** Direct ownership of production services with significant traffic, event volumes, or concurrency. You can explain their scale, bottlenecks, performance targets, and availability outcomes.
* **Strong backend and distributed\-systems fundamentals:** Python, APIs, asynchronous processing, data modelling, consistency, idempotency, duplicate and late events, checkpoints, and replay.
* **Hands\-on availability and recovery experience:** Replication, failover, backup and restore validation, and disaster\-recovery exercises, including recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO).
* **Production debugging and performance depth:** Experience diagnosing application, database, and infrastructure failures using logs, metrics, traces, profiling, and query analysis.
* **Applied AI engineering:** Experience shipping LLM applications or agents with tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and evaluations of correctness, latency, cost, and failure behaviour.
* **AI\-native development practices:** Effective use of coding agents while independently reviewing, testing, and taking ownership of the resulting software.
* **Sound operational judgment:** Clear reasoning about evidence, uncertainty, permissions, rollback, and when human intervention is required.

 **Useful additional experience**
Commerce, fulfilment, logistics, payments, observability, or workflow automation; Kubernetes/GCP; MongoDB; React; and operational attribution systems. **Our environment**
Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, GKE, Databricks, React, Prometheus, and Grafana. **What success looks like**
Your services meet agreed performance and availability objectives, recover predictably during failures, and have tested recovery procedures. Your AI workflows reduce investigation effort, improve attribution quality, and complete permitted actions with observable, verifiable outcomes. **What do we offer?****Growth**
At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.
We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.* Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we’ll reimburse the costs to support your development.

**Culture**
We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.* Regular community engagement and team\-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**
Your well\-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents **Work Environment**
We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.  

Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

title: Applications Support Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Job Description


The Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Application Support is a senior production support role responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, performance, and resiliency of business\-critical trading and market data applications. The role requires strong technical expertise, operational leadership, stakeholder management, and a proactive approach to driving continuous improvement across support processes, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.


The successful candidate will partner closely with business stakeholders, development teams, infrastructure teams, and vendors to provide high\-quality support, manage incidents, lead recovery efforts, and deliver strategic initiatives that improve application stability, effectiveness, and scalability. The role also serves as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor within the support organization.


Responsibilities:


* The Apps Support Senior Analyst provides end\-to\-end production support for critical trading and market data applications, ensuring high availability, stability, and performance while meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs).


* Perform start\-of\-day checks, continuous application monitoring, health assessments, and regional handover activities to ensure seamless business operations.


* Lead incident management, major incident triage, and service restoration activities, providing timely communication to business and technology stakeholders.


* Assess the risk and business impact of production incidents and ensure timely escalation, resolution, and stakeholder updates.


* Manage, maintain, and support applications and their operating environments, focusing on stability, resiliency, quality, and operational excellence.


* Act as the primary liaison between business users, traders, technology teams, infrastructure teams, and external vendors to drive issue resolution and service improvements.


* Provide short\-term resolutions for production issues and partner with development teams to implement long\-term strategic fixes.


* Drive stability, efficiency, effectiveness, and automation initiatives to improve application reliability and reduce operational overhead.


* Analyze application, infrastructure, and business process issues to identify root causes, recurring patterns, risks, vulnerabilities, and improvement opportunities.


* Lead and participate in application failover testing, disaster recovery exercises, technical upgrades, and resiliency validation activities.


* Support the full software release lifecycle, including planning, testing, deployment, implementation, post\-release validation, and production acceptance.


* Perform post\-implementation reviews and release health checks to ensure successful deployments and system functionality.


* Partner with development and engineering teams to prioritize bug fixes, technical debt reduction, and support tooling enhancements.


* Create, maintain, and continuously improve operational runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures, and technical documentation.


* Ensure adherence to operational processes, technology standards, governance requirements, and support best practices.


* Identify opportunities to maximize the value and effectiveness of supported applications through process optimization and technology enhancements.


* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for supported platforms and provide guidance to senior stakeholders, partner teams, and support personnel.


* Mentor and coach junior team members, promoting knowledge sharing, operational readiness, and technical skill development.


* Leverage monitoring, observability, and analytics tools to proactively identify risks, performance bottlenecks, and service degradation.


* Collaborate across infrastructure, application development, and business teams to deliver continuous service improvements and operational excellence.


* Make sound, data\-driven decisions in complex and time\-sensitive situations, applying strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.


* Lead and contribute to support\-related projects focused on platform modernization, operational transformation, automation, and process standardization.


* Utilize AI\-powered tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or similar technologies to accelerate troubleshooting, root cause analysis, automation, incident resolution, and operational efficiency improvements.


* Develop a strong understanding of business workflows, market operations, and application dependencies to support business objectives effectively.


* Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, regulatory requirements, risk management standards, and control procedures while safeguarding the firm's reputation, clients, and assets.


* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and transparency in managing production issues, control concerns, and operational risks.


Qualifications:


* \~5\-11 years of experience in Application Production Support, SRE, or related technology support functions.
* Strong understanding of production support processes, incident management, change management, and problem management.
* Experience supporting business\-critical applications within financial services environments.
* Good understanding of financial markets, particularly Equities and Fixed Income trading workflows.
* Proven track record of driving process standardization, automation, and operational improvements.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-pressure environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* **Experience leading major incident calls and interacting with global business and technology stakeholders.**
* **Technical Skills : Unix, Shell Scripting, GENEOS ITRS, Autosys, GRAFANA,SQL, Infrastructure knowledge, Data streaming tools and technology, System design, Open shift, ECS, ELK Tool , Release Engineering Support, Troubleshooting and major incident triage capability, working knowledge on automation tools, Good domain knowledge of Equities and Fixed income trading flow.**
* **Hands\-on experience using AI\-powered engineering and developer productivity tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or similar AI assistants to accelerate troubleshooting, root cause analysis, incident resolution, log analysis, code review, automation development, and production support activities.**
* **Soft Skill : Excellent Communication Skill, Able to lead major incident call and speak with global stake holders.**

Education:


* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
